values.title: Ship the apps spike report
values.content: Summarize spike 1 + 2 findings for the team. Include the **zero-shot patch** result.

values.title: Convex function taxonomy
values.content: queries = deterministic + cacheable, mutations = transactional, actions = escape hatch. Reactivity falls out of the read contract.

values.title: App marketplace idea
values.content: Agents could publish app definitions as installable templates — one JSON doc per app makes this cheap.

values.title: Layout tokens not pixels
values.content: Spacing enums (`none…xl`) keep agent-authored layouts consistent — no 13px surprises.

values.title: Wire rating filter into Bookmarks
values.content: Follow-up: replace the 7-table workaround with `filters` bound to a Select now that `/ui/*` exists.

values.title: DivKit ships a JSON Schema of its DSL
values.content: Strongest validation story of the surveyed JSON-UI systems — mirrors our generated catalog artifact.

values.title: Weekly review ritual
values.content: Friday: sweep unpinned notes older than a month — archive or promote to tasks.
